items.a: No. No signals, no alerts, no buy or sell recommendations. Meridian offers methodological tools and generic strategies to structure your approach.

For traders who are past the 'learning which buttons to press' phase and want to structure a durable approach: journaling, risk management, method, audit.
Meridian's tools and strategies are generic. They apply to most liquid markets: forex, indices, stocks, futures, crypto. The examples are deliberately neutral.

items.q: What is free, what is paid?
items.a: The documented strategies and some basic tools are free. The premium tools (full journal, advanced audit, training modules) will be paid as they are released.

items.q: Is there a Discord or community?
items.a: Not for now. Meridian is a suite of tools and content, not a community. The goal is autonomy, not dependence on a group.
No. No tool, method or strategy guarantees results. Trading carries a risk of capital loss. See the financial disclaimer.
